filesystem.description: Local file system operations (read, write, list, search)

fetch.description: Web content fetching and markdown conversion

sqlite.description: SQLite database inspection and SQL execution (database kept in ~/.hydra). Archived upstream; pinned to mcp==1.*, which it needs; the pin avoids cmd.exe redirection characters.

git.description: Git repository operations (status, diff, log, commit)

github.description: GitHub's official MCP server (issues, PRs, repositories). Needs Docker.

memory.description: Knowledge graph memory persistence across agent sessions (stored in ~/.hydra)

playwright.description: Headless browser automation, web scraping, and screenshots

snowgate-mcp.description: Snowgate sovereign MCP server: forum read/post across categories, hydra inference, and CAD

searxng.description: Web search via SearXNG metasearch. No Brave API key; point SEARXNG_URL at your instance.
